description: This file defines a React custom hook `useLessons` that provides access to lesson-related API functions. It utilizes `useMemo` to create a stable set of actions that are exposed to components, enabling them to perform operations such as fetching lessons, retrieving lesson details, quizzes, submitting quiz answers, and obtaining progress data. The hook acts as a wrapper around the `lessonsApi` module, offering a simplified interface for lesson management within a React application.

methods.name: useLessons()
methods.description: A React hook that returns lesson-related API actions as a stable object, allowing components to perform lesson operations without internal state management.
